subject: Culture
title: Kosher and Halal
description: A fast breakdown of Kosher and Halal for builders.

hook.text: Both Jews and Muslims avoid pork. The rules overlap but the theology behind them differs.

buildup.text: Kosher law separates meat and dairy entirely. Halal focuses on how the animal is slaughtered.

discovery.text: Both systems require an animal to be healthy and killed swiftly. Suffering makes the meat unfit.

twist.text: In modern cities, halal and kosher certifications drive billion-dollar industries. Faith shapes markets.

climax.text: Dietary law isn't just restriction. It's a daily practice that makes every meal an act of faith.

punchline.text: What you refuse to eat defines who you are.

quiz.question: What is a key difference between kosher and halal dietary laws?
options: Kosher separates meat and dairy; halal does not
